meta.disclaimer: Public M5 Walmart sales data (Kaggle). Inventory cover is simulated with a simple reorder policy — not real on-hand. Not affiliated with Walmart or any retailer.

source.name: M5 Forecasting Accuracy (Walmart / Kaggle)
source.license_note: Public M5 competition data mirrored on Hugging Face. Not affiliated with Walmart.
source.filter: 3 California stores (CA_1, CA_2, CA_3) × top 80 items by total unit volume across those stores over d_1..d_1941

methods.system_plan: Pure trailing 28-day mean of prior days (no leakage). Built daily; locked WMAPE/bias scored on weekly rollups. Won this holdout vs a YoY blend.
methods.challenge_check: 50/50 same-weekday-last-year (364-day lag) + trailing 28-day mean, weekly rollup (notebook only): 27.4% WMAPE / -3.5% bias — LOST to the pure trail on this holdout (level drift vs last year).
methods.inventory_sim: Start on-hand = 3.0 × pre-holdout avg weekly sales; each week deplete by actual sales; reorder up to 3.0 weeks of plan with lead time 1 week. Simulated — not real Walmart inventory.
methods.tile4_choice: Chose overstock share (WOS>4); simulated stockouts were under 0.5% of holdout demand.
methods.scoring_grain: Weekly for locked WMAPE/bias (buyer plan grain); daily plan construction.
methods.note: No neural nets, Prophet, XGBoost, LightGBM, or deep learning. Locked the simple method that won.

meta.display_note: Board labels use plain English (Foods item 362 · California store 3). Underlying M5 item_id / store_id stay in the data for verify.

wmape_system.label: Plan missed sales by
wmape_system.definition: Weekly WMAPE of the trailing-28-day system plan vs actual on the 28-day holdout (daily plan summed to weeks). Lower is better.

bias_pct.label: Plan ran high by
bias_pct.definition: sum(plan − sales) / sum(sales) on weekly holdout rollups. Positive = over-forecast.

avg_weeks_of_supply.label: Avg cover
avg_weeks_of_supply.definition: Simulated ending inventory ÷ that week's sales, averaged across items with sales on the last week. Not real Walmart on-hand.

overstock_share_pct.label: Items over a month of stock
overstock_share_pct.definition: Share of items with more than 4 weeks of simulated cover on the last week.
overstock_share_pct.plain: 1 in 10 items over a month of stock

scenario.name: FOODS +10% Mother's Day / spring-holiday lift (holdout window)
scenario.one_sentence: If FOODS sells 10% hotter over the holdout (Mother's Day week in window), that is about 7,394 extra units (~$14,819). Check whether simulated cover can take the lift before you buy.
scenario.plain: If FOODS sells 10% hotter → +7.4k units / ~$15k — check whether stock can cover it
